messages:
fran: Heads up from today's onboarding: the README for the sample app has three small but painful issues that keep tripping up new users. Filing here so we can track fixes.
matt: What are they?
fran: 1) Node snippet uses process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN but our SDK expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. 2) The JavaScript example omits await on client.generate() which causes unhandled promise rejections in some runtimes. 3) Python sample shows `from redwood import client` which is not an exported symbol.
rachel: Oof. Those will definitely create noisy support tickets. Can you paste the offending Node snippet?
fran: Sure — current README shows:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN })
client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' }).then(res => console.log(res))
```
matt: Fixes: switch to REDWOOD_API_KEY, show both await and .then forms explicitly, and add a quick note about PowerShell vs bash env var syntax. Proposed replacement:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
// POSIX
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' })
console.log(res)

// or promise style
client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' }).then(res => console.log(res))
```
rachel: For Python, we should show the import and construction clearly:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(prompt='hello')
```
fran: Also recommend adding a one-line troubleshooting section: "If you see 401s, confirm you're using REDWOOD_API_KEY (not older REDWOOD_API_TOKEN or RW_*), and ensure the snippet's auth header uses 'Bearer <key>' in curl examples."
matt: Good call. Can we also add a small test to docs-lint that looks for common mistakes: REDWOOD_API_TOKEN, RW_API_KEY, and "Authorization: Token"? That would catch regressions.
rachel: I'll take the lint rule. Simple regex checks and unit tests should be straightforward.
docs-bot: Current README: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/samples/sample-app/README.md
fran: I'll open a tiny PR that updates the snippets, adds the await example, and expands the troubleshooting section. Will request backport to v1-readme branch too.
matt: Nice. Please include the PowerShell env var example (setx vs $env:) so Windows users don't copy the wrong syntax.
fran: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/980 - small README fixes + troubleshooting note. CI will run.
lint-bot: docs-lint queued for PR 980. Will run snippet checks.
rachel: Once lint rule lands, let's add a short note to the onboarding playbook: "copy snippets using the quick-copy button to avoid accidental token name drift". Onboard-bot can nudge SEs during handoffs.
onboard-bot: Noted. I will add a checklist item to partner onboarding templates.
fran: Thanks all — closing after PR merges and backport lands.
